title: OpenStax IA 2e Try It 9.118: complete the square and check graphs
stem_student: Rewrite f(x) = 2x^2 − 8x + 3 in the form f(x) = a(x − h)^2 + k by completing the square. Then use graphing technology to compare the graph of your vertex form with the graph of the original standard form.
stem_teacher: A2.8 verify-with-technology beat on a licensed a ≠ 1 Try It. Completing the square is required; do not switch to the vertex formula. Graphing-technology compare language follows the A2.7/A2.8 seed statements, not a new Ministry example.
answer_verification: Author-computed completing-the-square rewrite of the licensed stem: 2(x^2 − 4x) + 3 = 2(x^2 − 4x + 4) + 3 − 8 = 2(x − 2)^2 − 5. Equivalence is the identity of the rewrite; technology should show one curve. OpenStax student page lists Try It 9.118 without an inline solution; Answer Key was not copied.
